IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Tuesday, September 15, 2026**

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** is running the hottest board right now: 44 calls, 214 hands, and all of them are data center reposts. Gurtz, Cupertino, and MJ Electric are stacked at Port Washington with **$10/hr over scale** on the hourly, running 58–60 hours a week. That's the kind of consistent OT that pays for the move north. Wisconsin license required on some calls—check your card before you head up.

**LU-430 Racine, WI** is the sleeper play. Eleven calls, 76 hands, and Microsoft Mount Pleasant is paying **$62.51/hr** across Gerdes, Pieper, and Staff Electric. Long sleeves and conduit skills non-negotiable, but the work is locked in and the rate doesn't lie. Wisconsin JW or reciprocal only.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** has real volume: 64 calls, 431 hands, mostly **$42/hr** on indefinite calls. Miller, Inglett & Stubbs, and Whitehead are all running QTS Fayetteville at **$42** with 4–10s and mixed Sat schedules. It's bread-and-butter work, no per diem, but the board depth means continuous flow.

**LU-354 Salt Lake City, UT** is printing money on the data center circuit. Cache Valley and Winward at QTS and Facebook Eagle Mountain are all **$46.22/hr** with **$225 per diem incentives on each 10-hour day** worked Monday–Friday, plus Saturday OT bonuses. P&G Corrine is also steady at the same rate with 6–10s potentially moving to 6–12s. Book depth is tight at 125 hands across 23 calls—move fast if you hit Utah.

**LU-20 Dallas, TX** has mixed work. Morley Moss is running QTS Lancaster with CW/CE calls at mid-level, plus a **$44.72/hr** QAQC Inside JW position on 4–12s starting 5 a.m., orientation 9/22. Rosendin and Fisk round out the board at 26 calls and 130 hands—solid secondary market.

**LU-26 Washington, DC** lists 60 calls but zero pay data across JE Richards, Hanley Energy, and Aarow—all data center and controls work in Sterling, Ashburn, and Springfield. Book is soft at 359 hands on 60 calls. Take it only if you need the volume and can stomach the wait for rates to surface.

**The trend:** Data centers are eating every board in the union. Port Washington, QTS, Facebook, P&G—the hyperscale build-out is where the sustained hours and overscale premium live. Book depth is tight everywhere it matters.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Tuesday, September 15, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is running hot with 46 calls and ~140 hands—the biggest board on the sheet. NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. has 40 JL slots on distribution work with $125 per diem nights stayed plus a $125 bonus on 10-hour days, 6-10s, CDL required. Another 9 JL calls with them in Southern Ohio run 4-10s optional weekends at $125 PD. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS is splicing cable in Johnstown with $100/day per diem. Distro grind, solid money, deep book.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** sits on 41 calls, ~132 hands, with SERVICE ELECTRIC dominating. Their high-cert job hits **$56.80/hr** and requires Quanta Barehand Cert, $150/day PD. Seventeen JL slots at the same shop run **$46.8/hr** on GA Power energize work, still $150/day. FAITH ELECTRIC LLC is posting 7 JL spots at $49.8 with hotels provided. All PD locked at $150—Georgia's feeding the beast.

**LU-1393 Indianapolis, IN** flexes 41 calls on just 69 hands—tight ratio, quality work. KENT POWER is running **$67.18/hr** on 345KV transmission bundle rebuilds out of Gary and Kouts, $150/day PD, some 7-day weeks. MJ Electric's Fort Wayne lattice tower job runs **$56.66/hr** with room rent covered. Transmission work, high-end hourly, serious skill calls.

**LU-245 Toledo, OH** is undersized at 12 calls but loaded: JF ELECTRIC hits **$876.00** PD on 6-day distribution work in Van Wert (that's a package rate, not hourly—read the fine print). JW DIDADO transmission jobs run $225/day PD in Stryker and Sandusky. Tight board, premium work.

**LU-70 Forestville, MD** has 14 calls feeding DC/Virginia substation and transmission. Miller Bros substation work goes **$126/hr**, $125 PD. LE Myers transmission in Culpeper is **$55/hr**, $150 PD. Real money offshore of the District.

**LU-125 Portland, OR** flips the script with 28 tree work slots on wildfire restoration and routine veg management—that's where the dispatch is moving right now. Data centers and transmission are pulling, but storm and vegetation work is absorbing the deepest benches.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Tuesday, September 15, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is running the biggest board at 18 calls hunting 61 hands—nearly full employment on the Sego Project alone. BCS Mechanical's got 15 Journeyman Pipefitters and 13 Journeyman Plumbers locked into 4-10s starting August 3, plus 5 Apprentice slots. DSI's QTS gig in Eagle Mountain runs 5-8s with a **$10.00** rate on the pipefitter work. This is pure volume; if you're not booked, Salt Lake's the move.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** sits at 23 calls for 47 hands—Intel Ronler Acres in Hillsboro is eating up bodies across tool install work. Charter Mechanical's running Fitters and High Purity Fitters; Apollo's feeding CAD/BIM Detailers and Orbital Welders into the same site. The specialty skills (purity, orbital, detailing) are what's getting premium placement here, not commodity labor.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** shows 15 calls, 49 hands. Kiewit's got one call paying **$65.00/hr** with **$65 per diem**, CWI cert required, running 5-10s plus Saturday 8s on night shift with **15% shift diff**. That's the standout. US Eng. Metalworks is also hiring SS fitter and tube-bending specialists on night shift—specialty certifications are money here.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** has 6 calls chasing 27 hands at Cenovus maintenance and fab shops. Graham's running Pipefitters on 6-10s with spotty OT; Nooter's offering **$125/day per diem** with incentive pay on 7-10s. Gem's combo welders will test and hire fast—6-10 schedule with bennies locks quick.

**LU-213 St. John, NB** runs 10 calls into 59 hands—Irving Oil Refinery work (F3/F4 welder testing outages) and Irving Pulp & Paper night shift pipefitter gigs with Stuart Olson and CAM filling slots. Apprentice Instrument Techs available too on split shifts.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** is skeletal: 1 call, 12 hands, Four Seasons towers in Henderson starting Thursday with OSHA 10/30 required.

High-purity semiconductor fab and refinery maintenance are pulling hands hard; specialty certs (orbital, CWI, high-purity) are the only cards that guarantee rates above scale.
